repeat_rule: repeat structural comparison in both exposure regimes plus local control if finite validation forecasts; no development decision outcome selects cells
checkpoint_selection: minimum full-release vector position RMSE on 32 validation parents, updates 1/50/100/150/200
contact_window_sampling: 50% contact / 50% non-contact source intervals, shifted back 0..7 steps; overlapping labels reported by actual diagnostics
geometry: eight ballistic chords, analytic circle/capsule intersections, earliest surface per model interval
position: event-time integration and predicted initial penetration resolution, slop 0.001m, cap 0.02m
score_policy: learned contact score is auxiliary; geometric admission authorizes mechanics, never score scaling or 0.5 force gate
capacity: GRU32 vs two-layer local 32->96->32 control, counts reported
numerical_fixture_flag: 1920/3840 Hz maximum path difference >0.05m or onset counts differ; retain all flagged cases
gate: improve pre-influence and no-effect mean/p95 against E0 and frozen A on validation, retain contact response/difference sensitivity; inspect ramps and prevalence before T4/T5
repeat_decision: All five seed-0 cells had finite validation forecasts; repeat the entire matrix, without selecting on development decisions.
